article.story: Seton Hall Pirates (3-0) at Alabama Crimson Tide (3-0) Tuscaloosa, Alabama; Friday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: No. 18 Alabama faces Seton Hall after London Jemison scored 20 points in Alabama's 109-68 victory against the Oakland Golden Grizzlies. Alabama went 12-3 at home a season ago while going 25-10 overall. The Crimson Tide shot 45.5% from the field and 35.8% from 3-point range last season. Seton Hall went 21-12 overall a season ago while going 6-5 on the road. The Pirates shot 43.5% from the field and 30.5% from 3-point range last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
